clips.title: The story
paras: The Bones of Grakkarond are the skeletal remains of a massive bronze dragon lying bleached under the sun of central Silithus. Slain during the ancient War of the Shifting Sands, this fallen wyrm serves as a grim monument held sacred by the qiraji's Anubisath sentinels.

Sprawled across the windswept dunes of central Silithus lies the colossal ribcage and skull of Grakkarond, a bronze dragon who met his demise during the ancient War of the Shifting Sands. In that apocalyptic clash a millennium ago, the great dragon was struck down by Ossirian the Unscarred, an Anubisath warrior elevated by the dark powers of the city-kingdom. To the Anubisath, this battlefield trophy is a sacred testament to their might over the dragonflights, left untouched where he fell.
